title: Depth increase (DEPTH=10, ASPECT_RATIO=64)
description: Increased transformer depth from 8 to 10 layers, keeping embedding dimension fixed at 640
reflection: First attempt with DEPTH=10, ASPECT_RATIO=72 exceeded VRAM. Switched to ASPECT_RATIO=64 to match a2/a5 proposals. Result: val_bpb=1.000827 vs baseline 0.996598 (0.42% regression). Deeper-but-narrower model underperformed. The baseline carefully balances depth and width; simple depth increase reduces embedding capacity. Suggests width matters at least as much as depth for this fixed-time regime. Consensus depth-increase idea appears wrong, or other agents will find better dimension balance.
